page.layout: One column of index entries, set in narrow lines with hanging indents, filling the page from top to bottom. No marginal notes. Running head above the column. No page number, catchword or signature in this part.; One column of index entries on the left, with the letters K. and L. as sub-headings; at the foot the signature at left and the page number at right.

main_text.l: Menfis & dies ex codice de je-
Judæa à Sofio subacta ex Tacito & Fastis triumphalibus asseritur. p. 78. 79.
Julia ablegatio in exilium facta An. Jul. 44. p. 109. &c. ante hanc Philippus Juliada condidit. p. 110.
Justinus Martyr anticipat æram nati Christi vulgarem p. 5. ejus sententia exponitur & cum nostrâ conciliatur. p. 207.

KEplerus adducitur, ejusque error circa mensem emortualem Herodis detegitur. p. 87. item, circa eclipsin lunarem Josepho memoratam. p. 104. &c. malè defendit diem Christi natalem ad 25 Decembris ponendam. p. 35. 36.
Locus, ubi Christus in exilio Ægyptiaco latitavit, incertus, atque sufficit ut fuerit Judææ proximus. p. 183. &c.
Lucas evangelista non censendus est ignorasse præcisum tempus ætatis Christi: contra Keplerum. p. 56. ejus testimonium cap. 3: 1. 21. uti vulgò urgetur, haud definit annum Christi natalem. p. 44. &c.
Lucius, Caji frater minorennis, ad honores publicos elatus An. Jul. 44. p. 89.

page.notes: Lines 1-3 of the first entry are cut in the photo, so the start of the column may be missing; the word "aɑ." is a doubtful abbreviation for "ab." or "ad" as printed. "mendæ" is doubtful. Blue underlines and numbers in the scan are reader's marks, not print, and are left out. Some words in the first entries are slightly rubbed and read with uncertainty. The page number at the foot right is faint and read as "17" (possibly "ɪɣ" in print). The large initial K of "Keplerus" is joined to the word as "KEplerus"; the second letter is read as E, but the scan is doubtful there. "1. 21." in the Lucas entry is doubtful: the scan shows "x. 2i.", which may be "1. 21." or "x. 21." Blue marks and the dark blotch at the right edge are digitiser or scanning marks, not print, and are left out.
